name: Akron White French Dressing

ingredients.name: spicy brown mustard, such as Bertman Ball Park Mustard

instructions.primary_message: Using a fine-mesh strainer or colander, rinse the onion under warm (about 110°F; 43°C) running water for 1 minute, shaking to ensure that all surfaces are rinsed. (This tames sulfurous flavor and aroma compounds in the onion.) Turn off the water and shake the onion dry over the sink.

In a blender or food processor, combine onion, garlic, vinegar, mustard, sugar, white pepper, and salt and blend until smooth, about 30 seconds. Add mayonnaise and blend just until fully incorporated, 15 to 20 seconds. (Careful: Overdoing it can weaken the emulsion.)
Season to taste with salt, if needed. Transfer to a jar or squeeze bottle and refrigerate overnight (6 to 12 hours) before serving.

schema_metadata.keywords: Akron White French Dressing Recipe, salad dressing, French dressing

description: Akron white French dressing is ultra-creamy, sweet-tangy, and perfect for any green salad—plus great as a coleslaw base, dip, or steak sauce.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 6 hr 5 min.

Make-ahead and storage: The dressing can be refrigerated for up to 2 weeks.
author: Jed Portman
